items.question: Is my money safe with a SEBI RIA?
items.answer: Absolutely. SEBI RIAs are regulated and fiduciary advisors — we work in YOUR best interest, not for commissions. Your money stays in your own demat/MF account at all times.

items.question: What is the minimum investment to start?
items.answer: You can start a SIP with as little as ₹500/month. For comprehensive advisory, I typically work with clients who have ₹2L+ to invest. Book a free call to discuss your situation.

items.question: How do I track my investments?
items.answer: All your investments are visible in your own Kuvera or Zerodha account. I also send monthly portfolio summaries and review calls every quarter.
